post.caption:
Bone has a higher strength-to-weight ratio than steel or concrete, and unlike steel it repairs itself. It manages that by being a composite: collagen fibres for flex, mineral crystals for hardness, and a hollow shaft for strength without the mass. It is also never finished. Osteoclasts dissolve old bone while osteoblasts lay down new, constantly remodelling to match load. That is why astronauts lose bone density and why weight-bearing exercise builds it.
